name: multilingual-hi
notes: Hindi evaluation corpus (E9-S6). Synthetic: audio is generated on the benchmark Mac with the system Hindi voice (Lekha) so it is licence-free and reproducible. Sentences are original, short, and contain no personal data. A human reviewer must confirm the references before any result is recorded in the support matrix. A Telugu copy uses the voice Geeta (te_IN) with Telugu references. Run: scripts/run-e2e-benchmark.sh with LEMMETYPE_BENCHMARK_CORPUS pointing here. Scores the English translation (WER against `english`); remove `task` to score the Hindi text against `text`.

utterances.text: कल दोपहर बारह बजे हम मिलते हैं।
utterances.english: We will meet tomorrow at twelve noon.

utterances.text: मुझे दस मिनट देर हो जाएगी, कृपया शुरू कर दीजिए।
utterances.english: I will be ten minutes late, please go ahead and start.

utterances.text: बैठक शुक्रवार को तीन बजे है।
utterances.english: The meeting is on Friday at three o'clock.
I will not come to the office today.

utterances.text: मैं शाम तक रिपोर्ट भेज दूँगा।
utterances.english: I will send the report by the evening.
